text: Evening. I'm looking after my granddaughter Rosie overnight, she's 10 months old, and I'm afraid I'm worn out and not quite sure what to make of things. She had a temperature of 38.6 about an hour ago. She won't settle off to sleep tonight. Every time I put her down she's up again, but otherwise she's been fine in herself, wide awake, babbling at me, looking about and grabbing my glasses as usual. What's bothering me is the soft spot on the top of her head. When I was stroking her hair I noticed it's sticking up, bulging out, rather than being flat or a bit dipped like I remember it. It's like a little dome. She's sitting up now, not crying, and it still looks raised. Her mother's on a night shift and I don't want to worry her if it's nothing, but I thought I'd better ask someone who knows.
